### Pointers to members

- A pointer to member keeps the type `memptr(C, Q, T)` through the passes (`cpp_is_type`), so deduction and
  `__weak_result_type`'s specializations match it (`cpp_match_one`). (0.88)
- AN OPERATOR'S ADDRESS IS A POINTER TO MEMBER TOO, `&C::operator()` ([expr.unary.op]/4; 0.201; a `cpp_expr` clause
  on `addr(scoped(Path, operator(Op)))`, its access checked as a named member's is): the clause took an atom name alone,
  and the operator's name was taken apart, `type_error(atomic, operator('()'))`. libc++'s guide of `std::function` strips
  `&_Fp::operator()` to the call's signature, so `std::function g{[](int x) { return x + 1; }};` deduced nothing.
  `ctadstd.cpp`. (0.201)
- A pointer to a data member is its byte offset, an `i64` (`cpp_member_address` over `cpp_offsetof`); `x.*pm` and
  `p->*pm` read `*(T *) ((char *) &x + pm)` (`cpp_memptr_read`). A member function pointer read as a value refuses
  `pointer_to_member_function_read`. A PLAIN struct's data member has one too (`cpp_member_address`'s clause over
  `ccl_tag/2`): a struct of data members alone stays C's and is no registered class, so `&Pt::x` met `no_member(Pt, x)` unless
  the program also derived from `Pt` -- while `std::invoke(&Pt::x, p)`, `std::mem_fn(&Pt::x)` and a ranges projection are written
  over exactly such aggregates; `cpp_memptr_object` takes a pointer to one as an object's pointer. `memptrdata.cpp`,
  `invokedata.cpp`. (0.99, 0.126)
- The member of a CONST object is const, and the member of an RVALUE is an xvalue ([expr.mptr.oper]/6, [expr.ref]/6;
  `cpp_memptr_qualify/4`, the one rule `__builtin_invoke` has in `cpp_invoke_result/4`): `x.*pm` carries the object's
  `const` (`const int &`) and, for an object that is no lvalue, is `T &&`; `p->*pm` carries the pointee's `const`. libc++
  18's `__invoke` reads `decltype(std::declval<_A0>().*std::declval<_Fp>())`, and `invoke_result_t<int Pt::*, const Pt &>`
  was `int &`, `<int Pt::*, Pt &&>` `int &`. A type the inference cannot settle leaves the plain read. `memptrqual.cpp`,
  `invokedata.cpp`. (0.126)
- A pointer to member function is `{ ptr, adj }`, 16 bytes aligned 8 (`ccl_size_align`, `ir_type_`), with the fields
  `ptr` and `adj` (`ccl_members_of_`, `ir_member_slot`), built by a cast (`ir_expr(cast)`, `ir_gconst`). `ptr` is the
  address, or `1 + slot offset` for a virtual member (`cpp_slot_offset`, 8 bytes a slot). An overloaded member's
  address refuses `overloaded_member_address`. `memfnptr.cpp`. (0.100)
- A call through it (`cpp_memptr_call`) moves `this` by `adj`; an odd `ptr` indexes the object's own table, read as the
  member's class, an even one is the function. `(obj.*pm)(args)`, `(p->*pm)(args)` and `__builtin_invoke(pm, obj, ...)`
  take this road. A base's member pointer converted to a derived class's adds the base's offset to `adj` ([conv.mem];
  `ir_convert`). `memfnadj.cpp`. (0.100, 0.108)
- A MEMBER FUNCTION TYPE'S QUALIFIERS (0.181; the reader's `q(V, Qs)`, `cpp_fn_q/3`): `&A::cf` of a const member is
  `int (A::*)(int) const` (`cpp_mfq_v/3`, over the member's `const` and ref-qualifier; a member's `volatile` the reader
  drops), and the type key holds them (`A_mp_Kfn_int_int`, `fnO`), so an overload, a specialization (`S<R (C::*)(int)
  const>`) and an instance over one are their own, and a target's qualifiers choose an overloaded member's address
  (`int (B::*pc)() const = &B::get` is the const `get`). A call through one checks the object's rights
  ([expr.mptr.oper]/6, [over.match.funcs]/5; `cpp_memptr_obj_ok/3`): a const object takes only a const member, an
  lvalue no `&&` member and an rvalue no `&` member -- from C++20 one whose qualifiers are exactly `const` (P0704) --
  else `non_const_member_on_const(pointer_to_member, C)` or `ref_qualified_member(pointer_to_member, C, Q)`, which a
  detection reads: `is_invocable_v<int (A::*)(int), const A &, int>` held. `memfnq.cpp`, `memfnq20.cpp`. (0.181)
- A NULL POINTER TO A DATA MEMBER IS -1, on both machines (0.161; the Itanium ABI's and ARM's: offset 0 is the first
  member's): a null pointer constant converted to one (`ir_convert/6`; the desugaring's own offsets are `long` literals,
  never a null constant's `int`), a global's constant (`ir_gconst`), and the zero-initialization of every type that
  holds one through its arrays and its members by value ([dcl.init]/6) -- a global without an initializer, an
  aggregate's missing items, an array's rest, `T t{}`, `new T()`, a value-initialized class -- spelled with the -1s by
  `ir_null_const/3` and stored after the zero bytes of a new-expression's block (a `calloc`'s before 0.202) or of a
  `memset` by the desugaring (`cpp_zero_not_null/3`,
  `cpp_zero_stmts/5`). One tests true where it is no -1, and a base's converted to a derived class's grows by the base's
  offset, null kept null ([conv.mem]/2). Two pointers to members compare ([expr.eq]/4; `ir_memptr_cmp/8`): both brought
  to one type, a data member's as integers, a member function's by clang's rule -- equal ptrs and either a null ptr or
  equal adjs; on arm64 equal ptrs and either equal adjs or a null ptr and no virtual mark. A member function that a BASE
  declares, named through the derived class, is the base's member pointer, converted where the derived class's is wanted
  ([expr.unary.op]/3; `cpp_method_base/3`). Each was a silent wrong answer or a refusal: `&C::a` of a first member
  tested null, `int C::*t = s;` over a second base's member read C's first, `p == nullptr` was false for a null p and
  two of them had no type, `H h{}` held 0, `&C::va` was `no_member(C, va)` and `CM none = nullptr` a `ptrtoint` LLVM
  refused. `memptrnull.cpp`, built and run on aarch64 too.
- ON arm64 THE FORM IS ARM's (0.161; `ccl_memptr_arm/0`, clang's ItaniumCXXABI with `UseARMMethodPtrABI`, Linux's and
  Apple's): a function's address may be odd there, so the virtual mark is `adj`'s low bit and `adj` is twice the `this`
  adjustment; a virtual member's `ptr` is its slot's byte offset (`memfn(Off, 1)`, `cpp_method_address`), a null one has
  `ptr` null and the mark clear (`ir_memfn_nonnull/2`: a virtual member at the table's first slot has `ptr` 0), a call
  shifts `adj` right once (`cpp_memptr_call`), and a base's member pointer converted to a derived class's adds twice the
  offset. In x86-64's form a pointer clang++ built for aarch64 was read as a plain function and a virtual call jumped to
  the slot's offset, a crash: the C++ gate's and the cross gate's `memptr` checks, against clang++'s code both ways.

### The array cookie

- `new T[n]` of a class that constructs or destroys (`\+ cpp_trivial_class`) uses the Itanium array cookie
  (`cpp_new_objects`). `::new T[n]` and `::delete[]` decide it by the GLOBAL functions, a class's own sized `operator
  delete[]` being no candidate of theirs ([expr.new]/12, [expr.delete]/10), as clang decides it (`gcookie.cpp`, 0.203:
  Not done's note of 0.202, which called it the class's, was wrong). A class with a destructor gets one, and since 0.202
  one whose array deallocation function is a sized one ([expr.new]/15, the Itanium ABI 2.7; `cpp_array_cookie/2`): the
  count, in max(8, alignof(T)) bytes before the first element. The block is the array allocation function's, its size
  the cookie and the elements (0.202). The elements are made in place, by the default constructor or from braced items,
  the rest value-initialized; a constant bound that the items cover asks no default constructor (`cpp_items_cover/2`,
  0.202: `new A[2]{A(1), A(2)}` of a class without one was refused `no_constructor`). (0.108, 0.202)
- `delete[]` reads the count, destroys in reverse and gives the block back from the cookie's start, a sized function
  told its size (`cpp_delete_array/3`, 0.202). `new T[n]()` and `new T[n]{}` of a trivial type are the block's zero
  bytes, calloc's before 0.202; `new int[n]{a, b}` stores the items over the zeroes (`cpp_new_scalars`).
  `arraycookie.cpp`, `newarray.cpp`. (0.86, 0.108, 0.202)

### The Itanium mangler

- The compiler's own definitions keep its own names (`C.m.k`, `F.<keys>`, `C.dtor.0`). A name that the shipped library
  defines takes its Itanium symbol from `cpp_ita_*` (the libc++ section says which). A name the mangler cannot spell
  keeps the compiler's name, so the link names it. (0.61, 0.73)
- A function is `_ZN <namespace path> <len>name E <parameters>` (`cpp_ita_function/7`), `v` for no parameter and `z`
  for an ellipsis. `St` is std and no substitution candidate; `St3__1` is one. A function directly in std is
  `_ZSt<len>name<parameters>`. (0.61, 0.73)
- A NAME'S `<len>` COUNTS ITS UTF-8 BYTES (0.196; `ccl_byte_length/2` at each length the mangler writes): `int
  ñs::naïve(int)` is `_ZN3ñs6naïveEi`, as clang++ mangles it, where cocolog 2 counts an atom's characters. (0.196)
- The substitution table is threaded through (`cpp_ita_sub`, `cpp_ita_note`): each prefix level, nested name and
  non-builtin type is a candidate in the order met, and its second occurrence is `S_`, `S0_` ... in base 36. A builtin
  is none; each layer (`P`, `R`, `O`, `K`) is one of its own, inner first. (0.73)
- A class type is `N <prefix> <chain> E` (`cpp_ita_class` over `cpp_class_scope`), or `St<len>name` directly in std. Its
  key is the chain's own, so the type and the same prefix level are one entity (`RS3_`). An instance is `<len>name I
  <args> E`, its template-name prefix and its template-id each a candidate. A VALUE argument is `L`, the template
  parameter's type (else the literal's), the number (`n` before a negative one), `E` (`cpp_ita_targs_t/6`; 0.137,
  Itanium 5.1.5.4): `ratio<1, 1000000000>` is `5ratioILl1ELl1000000000EE`, a bool `Lb1E`; a placeholder's by the
  literal's own type, an enumeration's by its enumeration (0.203; `cpp_ita_value/3`: `L5Color0E`, `LN2ns1KE4E`), a typed
  value's cast by its type's code (0.199; `cpp_ita_literal/3`, `cpp_ita_lit_code/2`: `c`, `w`, `Ds`, `Di`, `x`, `y`,
  `s`, `t`, `a`, `h`, `n`, `o`, `Du`), so the type information of `S<5u>`, `S<'a'>` and `S<(short)3>` over `template
  <auto N>` is `1SILj5EE`, `1SILc97EE`, `1SILs3EE`, as clang++'s, where all three were `Li`. Only types were spelled
  before, so the shipped `__last_write_time(const path &, file_time_type, error_code *)` kept its plain name and the
  lowering met its raw alias (`fsrest.cpp`; `test/cpp.pl`'s `c45` spells two symbols as clang++ 18 does). (0.73, 0.75,
  0.137)
- A FUNCTION TEMPLATE'S INSTANCE IS NAMED BY ITS PARAMETERS (0.221; Itanium 5.1.5.4's <template-param-decl>, as clang 18
  and 21 spell it; `cpp_ita_fn_targs/5`, `cpp_ita_pdecl/4`): a type is its type and a type pack `J ... E`; a value is
  `L`, its parameter's type, the number, `E` -- and where the parameter's type is a placeholder or another parameter,
  the parameter's declaration comes first and the value takes its literal's own type: `TnDa` for `auto` (its top-level
  const dropped, [temp.param]/5), `TnDc` for `decltype(auto)`, `TnPDa` for `auto *`, `Tn` and the parameter's code for
  `T V` (`TnT_`, a substitution candidate), `TpTnDa` before an `auto...` pack's `J ... E`. A shipped instance's
  arguments were types alone, and one with a value argument kept this compiler's name: `std::__1::e<5>()` of `template
  <auto N>` is `_ZNSt3__11eITnDaLi5EEEiv`, `a<int, 3>(int, int)` of `template <class T, T V>`
  `_ZNSt3__11aIiTnT_Li3EEEiS1_S1_`. A value that is an address or an object (`X...E`, `L_Z...E`) is spelled by no
  clause, and the instance keeps this compiler's name. `test/cpp.pl`'s `c47` (nine symbols as clang++ 18 and 21 spell
  them). (0.221)
- A member is `_ZN [K] <class chain> <member> E <parameters>`, `K` for a const method; a constructor is `C1`, a
  destructor `D1` (`cpp_ita_member_name`). An operator has the ABI's code (`cpp_ita_op`: `rs`, `ls`, `pL` ...), the
  unary one with no parameter (`cpp_ita_unary`). (0.73, 0.75)
- A function template's instance (`cpp_ita_fn_instance`) has the template-id in its nested name (its prefix a
  candidate, its own arguments never), the return type first, and a template parameter as `T_`, `T0_` ... (decimal),
  each a candidate: `_ZNSt3__16__sortIRNS_6__lessIiiEEPiEEvT0_S5_T_`. (0.92)
- A nested enum is a nested name of its holder (`cpp_ita_type_`; `cpp_class_scope_` finds the holder in `'$cpp_ctype'`):
  `..7seekoffExNS_8ios_base7seekdirEj`; else the stream fixtures failed to link. A program's global enum is a global
  name, `1K` (`cpp_ita_global`); else it resolved to itself without end. An enum of the program's namespace is its
  nested name, `N2ns1KE` (0.203: it was `1K`, the global clause taking it). `enumarray.cpp`. (0.94, 0.110)
- The holder's type must carry the enum's OWN last name (`cpp_class_scope_`, `cpp_last_segment`): an ALIAS of the enum
  in some class (`typedef _Tp value_type` of `__split_buffer<std::byte, ...>`) is no holder. Else `std::byte` was a
  member of that buffer, the chain of names named itself, and `std::vector<std::byte>` took 4 GB in ten seconds (a
  defect since 0.94, met once a library function template had a `byte` among its arguments). `stdbyte.cpp`. (0.117)
- The remaining builtin types are spelled (0.136; `cpp_ita_type_`): `_Complex T` is `C` and its real type's code, a
  substitution candidate as a pointer is; `_Float16` is `DF16_`; `_BitInt(N)` is `DB<N>_` and `unsigned _BitInt(N)`
  `DU<N>_` (`ccl_bitint_width`); the decimal floating types are gcc's `Df`, `Dd`, `De`. `test/cpp.pl`'s `c44` spells
  four symbols as clang++ 18 does. A VECTOR TYPE is `Dv<N>_<element>` (0.162), a `vector_size` one and an
  `ext_vector_type` one alike, a substitution candidate after its element (clang++'s `k(f2, f2)` is `_Z1kDv2_fS_`), its
  qualifiers before it (`RKDv2_f`); `c46` spells three symbols as clang++ does.
- `volatile` is spelled (`cpp_ita_cv/2`, 0.117): `V` before `K`, the group one substitution candidate with its type
  (`void const volatile *` is `PVKv`), and a by-value parameter loses both ([dcl.fct]/5). Dropped, libc++ 18's
  `__cxx_atomic_notify_one(void const volatile *)` was called by `..EPKv`, a symbol no library exports (every
  `-std=c++20` `notify_one`, `notify_all` and `wait` of a `std::atomic` failed at the link). `stdatomic20.cpp`.
- A C struct has its linkage name ([basic.link]): an unnamed one the first typedef that names it, asked before the type
  is resolved (`cpp_ita_c_struct`: glibc's `mbstate_t` is `__mbstate_t`), a named one its tag (`2tm`), a tag that no
  typedef names too (0.134: <time.h>'s `struct tm` -- `time_put<char>::put(iter_type, ios_base &, char_type, const tm *,
  const char_type *, const char_type *)` is shipped as `...PK2tmPKcSC_`, and the call kept this compiler's own name, an
  undefined symbol at the link of `std::put_time` and `std::get_time`). (0.94, 0.134)
- A tag is a C struct to the mangler where no class of that name is registered, or where the one registered stands in
  an `extern "C"` scope, `c` in the header index, or in the GLOBAL namespace, `[]` (0.134: `struct tm` stands before
  <time.h>'s `extern "C"`, and a header load registers it as a library class) (`cpp_ita_c_tag`). Why: glibc's
  `_IO_FILE`, registered by a header load, left `__is_posix_terminal(FILE *)` with its plain name, an undefined symbol
  at the link of `std::print`. (0.115, 0.134)
- The mangler works without the desugaring's registries (`cpp_class_known`): `test/cpp.pl`'s `c34` spells nine symbols
  as clang++ and the shipped library do. (0.73, 0.94)
- A FUNCTION TYPE, an ARRAY and a POINTER TO MEMBER are parameter types now (`cpp_ita_type_`; 0.117): a function type is
  `F <result> <parameters> E` (`z` for an ellipsis), so a pointer to it is `PF...E`; an array is `A <n> _ <element>`; a
  pointer to member `M <class> <type>`. A parameter of array or function type is the pointer it decays to and loses its
  top-level `const` ([dcl.fct]/5; `cpp_ita_fparams/6`), and the whole parameter type is one substitution candidate
  (`cpp_ita_whole/5`): `void (*)(int, ...)` is `PFvizE`, `int (&)[4]` is `RA4_i`, two `void (*)()` are `PFvvE` and
  `S1_` -- the symbols `std::set_terminate(void (*)())` is shipped under. `__int128` is `n` and `unsigned __int128` `o`.
  `test/cpp.pl`'s `c37`. Such a symbol kept this compiler's own name until 0.117, and the link named it. (0.73, 0.117)
- A MEMBER FUNCTION TYPE'S QUALIFIERS ARE SPELLED (0.181; `cpp_ita_fn/7`): `[V][K] F <result> <parameters> [R|O] E`,
  the qualified type one substitution candidate -- `int (A::*)(int) const` is `M1AKFiiE`, `&&` `M1AFiiOE`, `const &`
  `M1AKFiiRE` -- and the function type of a pointer to member takes a place in the table and is never substituted, as
  clang's mangler has it (`'$mfn'(Canon)`, keyed by the whole, so the same pointer to member again takes none):
  `void (*)(int (A::*)(int) const, int (A::*)(int) const)` is `PFvM1AKFiiES1_E`, and `int (*)(int)` before `int
  (A::*)(int)` `PFiiEM1AFiiE`, where it was `M1AS_`. The type information follows: `_ZTIM1AKFiiE` over `_ZTIKFiiE`.
  (0.181)

## Exceptions, RTTI, coroutines, modules, contracts and source locations

### Exceptions

- libc++ runs its exceptions configuration (0.193; its no-exceptions one from 0.50 to 0.192, and under
  `-fno-exceptions`): what its headers throw and what the compiled library throws reach the program's handlers
  (`ehlib.cpp`: a vector's and a map's `at`, an optional's `value`, an empty `std::function` called, a variant's wrong
  alternative, `substr`, `stoi`, each caught by its own type), a stream whose exceptions mask holds `failbit` throws
  `ios_base::failure` (`iosfailure.cpp`), a failed `dynamic_cast` to a reference throws `std::bad_cast` (`__cxa_bad_cast`;
  it called `abort`) and `typeid(*p)` of a null `p` `std::bad_typeid` (`__cxa_bad_typeid`; the table was read through
  null). Over the no-exceptions configuration (0.190's measure) a throw in the headers' code aborted with its message
  where clang++'s handler caught it, and a throw in the compiled library's own code (`std::stoi`) was caught either
  way. (0.50, 0.190, 0.193)
- The program's own `throw`, `try` and `catch` run over libc++abi (linked through `-lc++`, `ccl_link_libs` on Linux).
  `throw e` is `__cxa_allocate_exception`, the object built in place (`cpp_new_at`), then `__cxa_throw` with the
  type_info and the destructor; `throw E(args)` builds E in the exception's memory. `throw;` is `__cxa_rethrow`. An
  untyped throw refuses `throw_of_untyped`. `exceptions.cpp`, `exceptions2.cpp`. (0.108, 0.110)
- Where the program throws or catches (`'$cpp_eh_used'`, `'$ir_eh'`), and in every C++ program of the exceptions
  configuration (0.193), a call under a `try` or a scope with defers is an `invoke` (`ir_invoke_needed`). Its landing pad (`ir_landing_pad`, personality `__gxx_personality_v0`) lists the
  handlers' type_infos and `cleanup`, runs the defers of the scopes it leaves (`ir_unwind_to`), tests the selector with
  `llvm.eh.typeid.for`, and else resumes. Code run while unwinding makes plain calls. (0.108)
- A CLEANUP RUN AT A NORMAL EXIT RUNS UNDER WHAT IS LEFT TO RUN AND UNDER THE TRIES THAT ENCLOSE ITS FRAME (0.201;
  `ir_run_exit/2`, `ir_run_exit_bodies/3`, `ir_tries_within/3`): while a frame's defers run at a block's end, a `return`,
  a `break`, a `continue` or a `goto`, the defer stack holds the bodies not run yet and the frames outside, so a call in
  one that throws -- a destructor declared `noexcept(false)`, a defer's call -- unwinds through the rest alone
  ([except.ctor]/2: what is destroyed is what has not been); and the tries in force are those entered outside the frame
  ([except.throw]/2: the nearest handler is one whose try was entered and not exited), a try that the exit leaves
  catching nothing of its cleanups. A forward goto's trampoline runs under the goto's own tries (`fwd/8` records them,
  `ir_trampolines/3`). The landing pad made there ran the whole frame again, the body that threw among it: `~D()
  noexcept(false)` at the end of `{ D d; }` ran twice and the second throw, during the unwinding, was terminate's; and
  `D d; try { return 5; } catch (int) {...}` caught d's exception in the handler the return had left, and destroyed d
  again at the next return. `dtorthrow.cpp`, `throwexit.cpp`. (0.201)
- A CONSTRUCTOR THAT THROWS DESTROYS WHAT IT HAS BUILT ([except.ctor]/3; 0.201): each base and each member with a
  destructor, once built, is followed by `eh_cleanup(L, Body)`, the call of the destructor that the class's own
  destructor calls for that sub-object (`cpp_member_cleanup/4`, `cpp_first_base_cleanup/4`,
  `cpp_extra_group_cleanups/5` in `cpp_ctor_body/7`), which the lowering pushes into its scope's frame as
  `eh_only(Body)`, a defer that only a landing pad runs (`ir_stmt_(eh_cleanup)`, `ir_run_bodies/1`; the check and the
  evaluator take it as nothing): a throw from a later member's initializer or from the body destroys the built ones in
  the reverse of their construction, then propagates. They were left, their destructors never run: `T() : a(1),
  b(boom(2))` leaked a's string. A union's members get none. A virtual base that the complete object built is followed by
  its own (`cpp_vb_cleanup/5`, the virtual first base's by `cpp_first_base_cleanup/4`), and a delegating constructor's
  body by the class's destructor ([except.ctor]/4: the object its target completed). `ctorthrow.cpp`, `vbthrow.cpp`.
  (0.201)
- THE SAME CLEANUP FREES AND DESTROYS WHAT A THROWING INITIALIZATION LEFT (0.201): a new-expression's block where the
  constructor throws ([expr.new]/26; `cpp_new_ctor/5`: `free` of the block, an unwinding-only cleanup before the
  constructor's call -- `new T(9)` of a throwing constructor kept its memory, and `std::make_unique` with it); an array
  new's elements built, the last first, and its block ([except.ctor]/3; `cpp_new_objects/6`: a count of the elements
  built, `$abuilt`, and one cleanup over it); a local array's elements built (`cpp_elems_unwind/8`: each element's
  destructor after it, the elements' construction a block of its own, so the cleanups end there and the array's defer
  takes over); a static local array's too, its guard aborted. `T arr[5];` and `new T[5]` over a constructor that throws
  at the fourth left three elements built. `newthrow.cpp`, `throwinit.cpp`. (0.201)
- A CONSTRUCTOR'S OR A DESTRUCTOR'S FUNCTION-TRY-BLOCK ([except.pre]/1, [except.handle]/15; 0.201; the reader's
  `fntry(Body, Handlers)`, the C++ reader's Classes topic): the desugaring puts a constructor's bases, member
  initializers and body (`cpp_ctor_body/7`), and a destructor's body and its members' and bases' destruction
  (`cpp_dtor_body/4`), under one try. What was built is destroyed before a handler is entered (its cleanups lie inside
  the try, the bullet above), and the exception is rethrown where a handler's end is reached (`cpp_fntry_handlers/3`).
  Any other function's is the try it is. `fntryblock.cpp`. (0.201)
- A handler binds its parameter to `__cxa_begin_catch`'s object, with `__cxa_end_catch` as its scope's defer
  (`ir_handler`); `catch (...)` takes all. A class caught by value is a copy ([except.handle]/15; `cpp_catches`),
  destroyed at the handler's end. `catchvalue.cpp`. A POINTER CAUGHT is the pointer `__cxa_begin_catch` answers,
  adjusted to the handler's type, as clang stores it (`ir_catch_bind/3`, 0.179): it was loaded from where it points, and
  `catch (int *p)` crashed. `ptrrtti.cpp`. (0.108, 0.110, 0.179)
- The reader keeps `noexcept` (`'$ccl_nx'`): a free function's name joins the set `'$ccl_nxs'` (`ccl_note_nx`), a
  method keeps it among its qualifiers. `noexcept(false)` and `throw(X)` are not noexcept; `throw()` is, and so is
  glibc's `__THROW`, `noexcept (true)` in C++. A LIBRARY header's names go to a set of their own, `'$ccl_lnxs'`, which
  its summary carries (0.193; `ccl_seed_read/2`, the Includes topic). Any other `noexcept(E)` keeps its condition E
  (0.199, the C++ reader's topic): a method's qualifier `noexcept(E)`, a free function definition's `nxif(E, Sto)`.
  (0.110, 0.188, 0.193, 0.199)
- noexcept is enforced where the program throws (`'$cpp_throws'`; [except.spec]/5), and in every C++ program of the
  exceptions configuration (0.193), libc++'s code throwing: a noexcept function that makes a call or throws has its body
  in a `try` with a `terminate` handler (`cpp_nx_wrap`). It calls `std::terminate` and runs no destructor on the way
  (`ir_unwind_to`), as clang's pad does. `noexcept.cpp`. A CONDITIONAL noexcept guards the body only where its condition
  holds for the instance (0.199; `cpp_fn_nx_guarded/4`, `cpp_qs_guarded/4`):
  `template <class T> void thrower(T v) noexcept(sizeof(T) > 100) { throw (int) v; }` throws to its caller.
  `nxguard.cpp`. A body that throws with no call (`void d(int v) noexcept { if (v > 0) throw v; }`, a method's alike)
  and an instance of the program's function template declared `noexcept` are guarded too (0.199; `cpp_nx_may_throw/1`,
  the instance's storage `nxif(bool(true), Sto)`: the set `'$ccl_nxs'` holds the template's name, never an instance's):
  each let its exception leave it, where clang++ calls `std::terminate`. `nxplain.cpp`. (0.110, 0.199)
- `noexcept(e)` is false when e holds a `throw` or calls a function that is not noexcept (`cpp_nx_throws`): a program's
  free function not in `'$ccl_nxs'`, or a method with no noexcept overload of its name; and since 0.193 a library's: a
  free function or function template a header declares, called by its name or a qualified one, not in `'$ccl_lnxs'`
  (`std::stoi(s)` and `std::max(a, b)` false, `std::strlen(p)` and `std::move(x)` true), and a member function of a
  library class -- its own, a member template's, else the first base's that declares the name (`cpp_nx_method_quals/3`)
  -- none of whose declarations is noexcept (`v.at(0)`, `v.push_back(x)` and `in.good()` false, `v.size()` and
  `s.c_str()` true). A library function counted as noexcept until 0.193, libc++ running its no-exceptions configuration;
  a destructor counts as noexcept ([except.spec]/9). `noexceptlib.cpp`. And since 0.200 the CONSTRUCTORS A CALL RUNS
  ([except.spec]/6: an implicit call of a constructor for a function argument; `cpp_nx_args_init_throw/2`,
  `cpp_nx_class_named/2`): a by-value parameter of a class initialized by the constructor that takes the argument --
  none for a prvalue of its class, C++17's elision -- and a reference to a class bound to a temporary of another value,
  for a function template whose arguments the call gives and for a plain function of one overload of the call's arity; a
  temporary `T(args)` or `T{args}` of a class by its constructor, an aggregate's aside. Each was nothrow whatever
  constructor ran: libc++ 18's `is_nothrow_convertible` is `noexcept(__test_noexcept<_To>(declval<_Fm>()))` over
  `template <class _Tp> void __test_noexcept(_Tp) noexcept;`, and `is_nothrow_convertible_v<int, TH>` over a `TH(int)`
  that may throw was 1. `nxctors.cpp`, `valtraitsnx.cpp` (C++20). Since 0.205 it asks them of A MEMBER FUNCTION'S CALL
  too, its parameters initialized from the arguments where one declaration of the name takes as many
  (`cpp_nx_method_call_throws/3`), of a static member called through its class (`O::s(1)`), of A FUNCTION TEMPLATE'S
  CALL WHOSE ARGUMENTS IT DEDUCES, the parameters of the instance the call resolves to (`cpp_nx_instance_params/3`), of
  A CALL OF AN OVERLOAD SET of which several take as many arguments, the overload the call resolves to's
  (`noexcept(ov3(1))` over `void ov3(TH) noexcept` and `void ov3(const char *) noexcept`, TH's constructor from an int
  throwing), of a temporary's member call (`P().h()`, `W<false>{}.h()`: the value's class, `cpp_nx_value_class/2`), of A
  CALL OF AN OBJECT OF CLASS TYPE ([over.call]: its `operator()`'s, a closure's among them; `cpp_nx_object_class/2` --
  libc++'s `__invoke` calls `static_cast<_Fp &&>(__f)(...)`), and of a temporary of a class named by a typedef
  (`std::string("x")`, whose constructor from a `const char *` may throw; `cpp_nx_class_named/2`). Each was 1 where
  clang++ answers 0. `nxcalls.cpp`, `nxtemp.cpp`. (0.110, 0.188, 0.193, 0.200, 0.205)
- A CALL OF A FUNCTION WITH A CONDITIONAL NOEXCEPT ([except.spec]/2, /13; 0.199, reader 151, lowering 112): the
  condition is evaluated for each specialization. The desugaring substitutes it with an instance's bindings, its packs'
  among them (`cpp_subst_nxsto/3`), keeps it beside the emitted function's name (`'$cpp_nxdef'`; `'$cpp_nxsrc'` for a
  definition not emitted yet, noted before any body is walked), and evaluates it where it is asked: in its class's words
  with its parameters declared, unevaluated and isolated from the asker's scopes, folded as a constant condition
  (`cpp_nx_cond_value/4` over `cpp_const_bool/2`; one that does not fold holds, trace `nx_cond_unknown`, and one that
  asks itself again holds), once a function or a class and condition (`'$cpp_nxval'`, `'$cpp_nxmval'`). `noexcept(e)` of
  a call desugars the call, unevaluated, and reads the condition of the function it resolves to
  (`cpp_nx_callee_value/3`, `cpp_nx_named_value/2`): `noexcept(f(1))` of `template <class T> void f(T)
  noexcept(sizeof(T) > 4)` is false, `noexcept(f(1.0))` true, `noexcept(wi.g())` over `void g()
  noexcept(std::is_integral_v<T>)` true for `W<int>`. A member's condition answers the nothrow traits
  (`cpp_qs_nothrow/3`, below), and a hidden friend keeps its noexcept (`cpp_friend_item/3`: `friend void swap(A &, A &)
  noexcept` was dropped). A function template of the program declared without a noexcept-specifier may throw
  (`cpp_nx_prog_fn_template/1`: `noexcept(dv<T>())` over `template <class T> T &&dv();` held), a call with the
  template's arguments given is asked by the template's name, a noexcept function's name deduces its type with the mark
  (`cpp_deduce_type/2`: `inv(pn)` deduces `void (&)() noexcept`), and `__builtin_invoke(f, ...)` throws as f's type says
  (`cpp_nx_invoke_throws/1`; libc++ 21's `is_nothrow_invocable` asks it). Every condition but `false` held until 0.199:
  `std::is_nothrow_invocable_v<void (*)()>`, `std::is_nothrow_swappable_v<M>` over a move constructor `noexcept(false)`,
  and `noexcept(std::swap(m1, m2))` were 1. A FUNCTION TYPE'S CONDITIONAL NOEXCEPT is evaluated where the type is
  resolved, in the words of the class being walked (0.205, reader 155; the reader's mark `q(V, [nxif(E)])` on a
  pointer's, a reference's and a member function's type, `ccl_suffix//2` and `ccl_mfn_mark/5`, and `cpp_fn_nx_cond/2` in
  `cpp_type/2`): `void (*f)() noexcept(B)` of `template <bool B> int callp(...)` is a pointer to a noexcept function in
  `callp<true>` and to one that may throw in `callp<false>`, a pointer to member's alike; each counted as noexcept
  whatever B was. And its `noexcept(B)` DEDUCES B ([temp.deduct.type]/8, P0012; `cpp_match_fn_mark/5` in
  `cpp_match_one/5`): true where the argument's type is noexcept, false where it is not -- `callp(tf)` was
  no_matching_template. A condition the desugaring cannot fold holds, as a call's does (0.199; `cpp_fn_type_nx/1`). A
  lambda's noexcept is the Lambdas topic's (0.205). `nxcond.cpp`, `nxtrait.cpp`, `nxover.cpp`, `nxfnconv.cpp`,
  `nxtypedef.cpp`.
- NOEXCEPT IS PART OF A FUNCTION TYPE (C++17, [except.spec]/2, [dcl.fct]/1, P0012; 0.198, reader 150): the reader keeps
  it on a function TYPE -- a pointer's, a reference's, a type-id's -- as the mark `q(V, [noexcept])` of `fn(R, Ps, V)`
  (`ccl_suffix//2`), and on a member function type after its qualifiers (`ccl_mfn_mark/5`, `cpp_method_mfq/2`); a
  declared function's own type keeps the plain mark (`ccl_own_fn_nx/3`) and its noexcept the name's (`'$ccl_nxs'`), so
  that its symbol, its declare line and the table are what they were, and `decltype(nf)` and `decltype(&nf)` take the
  mark again (`cpp_decltype_of/2`). The type key holds it (`nxfn`, `cpp_type_key/2`), and the mangler spells it `Do`
  (`PDoFvvE`, `M1SKDoFivE`; `cpp_ita_fn/7`). A call through a pointer or a reference to a function, or through a pointer
  to member function, is noexcept where its type is (`cpp_nx_throwing/1` over `cpp_nx_pointer_callee/2` and
  `cpp_nx_memptr_fn/2`). The function pointer conversion takes the mark away and never adds it ([conv.fctptr];
  `cpp_fnptr_conv/2` in `cpp_convertible/2`, `cpp_fn_types_agree/2`, `cpp_mfq_fits/2`); a partial specialization over `R
  (*)(A...) noexcept` is one of its own; the lowering reads the ellipsis mark through it (`ir_variadic/1`, lowering
  111). The mark was dropped: `void (*p)() = nf;` made `noexcept(p())` true, `is_same_v<decltype(nf), void()>` and
  `is_convertible_v<void (*)(), void (*)() noexcept>` were true, a call through `.*` of a member that may throw was
  noexcept, and the type information of `void (*)() noexcept` was `PFvvE`. A TYPEDEF of a function type, `typedef void
  F() noexcept;`, keeps its mark since 0.205 (`ccl_typedef_nx/3`: the declarator's rule took it for a declared
  function's own type and stripped it, and the name's noted noexcept gives it back) -- a conditional one its condition,
  folded at the read where it is a constant, else the mark `nxif(E)` (`ccl_note_nxc/1`: `typedef void FC()
  noexcept(sizeof(int) > 8);` may throw, and a class template's `typedef void F() noexcept(B);` is its instance's) --,
  and `auto r = &nf;` and `auto s = nf;` deduce a pointer to a noexcept function, as `decltype(&nf)` has it
  (`cpp_nx_init_type/3`; the reader leaves such an `auto` to the desugaring, `ccl_auto_by_overload/1`): `noexcept(p())`
  over `FN *p = nf;` and `noexcept(r())` were 0. `lambdanx.cpp`, `nxtypedef.cpp`. A CONDITIONAL `noexcept(E)` was
  noexcept for every E but the literal `false` until 0.199, the reader keeping no E (the next bullet).
  `noexcepttype.cpp`.

### RTTI

- libc++ runs with RTTI, as clang++ builds it, since 0.191 (without it from 0.86 to 0.190; `-fno-rtti` gives that
  configuration, the Configuration chosen through the macros topic); the program's own `typeid` and `dynamic_cast` work
  over libc++abi since 0.108, and libc++'s headers' own typeids are the program's to lower alike. `rtti.cpp`,
  `rttilib.cpp`. (0.86, 0.108, 0.191)
- `typeid` of a type is its type_info (`cpp_rtti_of_type`); of a polymorphic object it reads `vptr[-1]` (`rtti_dyn`);
  since 0.180 only a type that the mangler cannot spell, or an expression with no type, refuses `typeid_of`. (0.108,
  0.180)
- A class's type_info is `_ZTI<name>` with the string `_ZTS<name>`, both `linkonce_odr` (`cpp_rtti_chain`,
  `ir_rtti_emit`): `__class_type_info` for a root, `__si_class_type_info` for one base at offset 0, `__vmi_class_type_info`
  for several bases, a virtual base, or one base behind the class's own table pointer (0.135: the first base's entry
  names its slot, `$base`, so libc++abi adjusts a pointer to it -- a `catch (P &)` of a thrown class whose base P lies at 8). A vmi entry is the base's offset x 256 + 2; a table-reached virtual base is flagged
  virtual at -24 (a nearly empty primary one at its own vbase offset's place, -10237 for -40, 0.174), a diamond sets
  `__diamond_shaped_mask`, and the bases are listed in the order written, a primary base moved first put back (0.174).
  (0.108, 0.110, 0.174)
- A program class is named as clang names it (`cpp_rtti_name`): at file scope `<len><name>` (`1A`); in a namespace of
  the program's own, nested, or an instance of the program's template by the mangler, which spells the program's types
  for the type information since 0.180 -- the program's functions keep this compiler's names -- through
  `cpp_class_scope_/3` over `cpp_prog_scope/2` and `'$cpp_type_ns'/2`, each type's namespace by the name it has once a
  collision is keyed (`cpp_ns_resolve/2`): `N2ns1AE`, `N5Outer5InnerE`, `3BoxIiE`, a plain struct's and a union's too
  (`N2ns1PE`). `typeid(Box<int>)` was `6Boxint`, `typeid(Outer::Inner)` `10OuterInner`, `typeid(ns::P)` `1P`, and
  `ns::A`, keyed `ns.A` where a global `A` collides with it, `3nsA`. `rttinames.cpp`. (0.108, 0.180)
- A library class's type_info is the shipped
  symbol (`_ZTISt13runtime_error`), a builtin's libc++abi's (`_ZTIi`, `_ZTIPKi`); a plain struct is a root. Only a
  POLYMORPHIC library class's is shipped (0.179): libc++ exports no other, and a library class without a table has
  its own `linkonce_odr` one, as clang emits it -- `typeid(std::complex<double>)` named `_ZTINSt3__17complexIdEE`, which
  the link did not find. A complex type's is clang's: `_ZTICd` over `__fundamental_type_info`, a pointer to one
  `_ZTIPCd` over `__pointer_type_info` (`cpp_complex_code/2`, `ir_rtti_emit/2`), where it was the real type's
  (0.179). A POINTER TO A CLASS or to a plain struct has clang's too, `_ZTIP1A`, `_ZTIPKNSt3__17complexIdEE`, over the
  class's own (`cpp_rtti_pointee/3`, 0.179): it was refused, `typeid_of`. `complexrtti.cpp`, `ptrrtti.cpp`. (0.108,
  0.179)
- THE TYPE INFORMATION OF EVERY OTHER TYPE (0.180), as clang emits it, `linkonce_odr`, its name the mangler's spelling
  of the type (`cpp_rtti_other/2`, `cpp_rtti_mangled/2`, `ir_rtti_emit/2`): an enum's over `__enum_type_info` (`5Color`,
  `4Mode`), an array's over `__array_type_info` (`A3_i`), a function's over `__function_type_info` (`FidE`), a pointer
  to member's over `__pointer_to_member_type_info`, the member's type and its class's (`M1Ai`, `M1AFiiE`), a vector's
  over `__fundamental_type_info` (`Dv4_i`), and a pointer to any other type over `__pointer_type_info`, its pointee's,
  the pointee's cv in its flags (`PPi`, `PKPKc`, `P5Color`, `PDv4_i`, `PVi`: a pointer to a volatile builtin was
  `_ZTIPi`). `typeid` of each was refused, `typeid_of`, and none could be thrown or caught. A BUILTIN TYPE THAT
  libc++abi DOES NOT EXPORT has its own (`cpp_abi_fundamental/1` names the codes libc++abi 18, 21 and 22 export, each
  with a pointer and a pointer to const): a `_BitInt(37)`'s `_ZTIDB37_`, as clang emits it, and a `_Float16`'s
  `_ZTIDF16_`, which clang declares external and libc++abi does not export (clang++'s link fails). `std::nullptr_t`'s
  is libc++abi's `_ZTIDn`, `typeid(nullptr)`'s too (0.180: resolved, its typedef `decltype(nullptr)` was a `void *`,
  `Pv`; the builtin's code `Dn` since 0.206);
  `throw nullptr` throws a `std::nullptr_t`, which a pointer handler catches as null, libc++abi's rule, and a
  `std::nullptr_t` caught holds null (`ir_catch_bind/3`: `__cxa_begin_catch` answers the exception object's address,
  which is no value of it). `rttiother.cpp` (C++20; its expect clang++'s, `_Float16`'s two symbols supplied).
- `dynamic_cast` to a base is a plain conversion. A downcast or a cross-cast calls
  `__dynamic_cast(sub, &src, &dst, -1)`, and null gives null without the call; a failed reference cast calls `abort()`.
  Another target refuses `dynamic_cast_to(T)`. `multibase3.cpp`, `vbasertti.cpp`. (0.108)
- `dynamic_cast<void *>` of a pointer to a polymorphic class is the complete object ([expr.dynamic.cast]/7): the node
  `dyncast(X, void, void, T)`, which the check and the inference read as the other casts, lowered as the address plus
  the offset-to-top at `vptr[-2]`, null kept null. A pointer to a class without a table refuses
  `dynamic_cast_to_void`. `dynvoid.cpp`. (0.112)

### Coroutines

- A body with `co_await`, `co_yield` or `co_return` (outside a lambda) takes LLVM's switch-resumed lowering. The
  desugaring makes it a skeleton (`cpp_coro_skeleton`), in order: 1. the promise's storage `$promise` declared; 2.
  `coro_begin`: `llvm.coro.id`, the frame from its allocation function (below), `llvm.coro.begin`, then the promise
  constructed in it ([dcl.fct.def.coroutine]/5, /10; 0.205, `coro_promise/3`: it was constructed first); 3. `coro_ret`:
  `get_return_object()`, converted as a return is; 4. the initial suspend's await; 5. `coro_body`, with a fall-off
  `return_void()` where the promise has one; 6. the final suspend's await; 7. `coro_done`: the defers, `llvm.coro.free`,
  the frame given back to its deallocation function, `llvm.coro.end`. (0.108, 0.202, 0.205)
- THE COROUTINE STATE'S ALLOCATION ([dcl.fct.def.coroutine]/9-12; `cpp_coro_alloc/5`, `cpp_coro_dealloc/1`; 0.202): the
  promise type's `operator new`, a member or a base's, over the frame's size (`coro_size`, `llvm.coro.size.i64`) and the
  coroutine's arguments, else over the size alone, else the global one; a promise with
  `get_return_object_on_allocation_failure` takes the nothrow form, and a null frame returns that function's result, the
  body never run and no promise built (0.205: the promise was built before the state was allocated and destroyed after a
  null one; `coronull.cpp`, C++20). It is given back to the promise type's usual `operator delete`, the sized one first,
  over the frame (`coro_mem`, `llvm.coro.free`'s pointer), else to the global sized one. Both were the global functions,
  the frame's given back unsized. `coroalloc.cpp` (C++20). (0.202, 0.205)
- `co_await e` is a statement expression over the awaiter, through `await_transform` where the promise has one:
  `await_ready()`; else `coro_suspend` (`llvm.coro.save`, `await_suspend(coroutine_handle<P>::from_address(frame))`
  whose void, bool or handle result decides, `llvm.coro.suspend`, a switch whose destroy edge runs each defer); then
  `await_resume()`. `co_yield e` awaits `yield_value(e)`. `co_return` calls `return_value` or `return_void`, runs its
  scopes' defers and goes to the final await. (0.108)
- The awaiter is the awaitable's `operator co_await`, member or free (`cpp_coro_awaiter`; `coawaitop.cpp`). The promise
  type is `std::coroutine_traits<R, Ps...>::promise_type` where the program specializes the traits, a method's object
  first (`cpp_promise_type`), else `R::promise_type`. The promise is built from the parameters where it has such a
  constructor (`cpp_promise_init`). Where the program throws, the body runs under
  `catch (...) { promise.unhandled_exception(); }` (`cpp_coro_guard`). `cotraits.cpp`. (0.110)
- libc++'s `coroutine_handle` builtins (`__builtin_coro_resume`, `destroy`, `done`, `promise`, `noop`,
  `__builtin_coro_frame`) are LLVM's intrinsics (`ir_coro_builtin`). The embedded LLVM runs `default<O0>` at `-O0` too,
  for its CoroSplit (`module/ccl_llvm.cicili`). (0.108)
- A promise with no `get_return_object` is refused (`test/cpp/coro.cpp`); a result with no promise type refuses
  `coroutine_result(R)`. `cogenerator.cpp`, `cotask.cpp`, `coeager.cpp`, `coawait.cpp`, `cotemplate.cpp` (C++20).
  (0.108)
- The ramp's return object lies OUTSIDE the frame by a rule (0.136): its alloca carries `!coro.outside.frame`
  (`ir_alloca_outside/3` in `ir_stmt(coro_ret(...))`), as clang marks its `coro.gro`; it had stayed out by LLVM's choice.

### Modules

- `export module M;` names the unit's module (`ccl_note_module`); `module;` and `module :private;` are nothing; `export`
  before an item or a braced group gives the items; `import <h>;` and `import "h";` are includes. (0.108)
- `import M;` reads M's interface (`ccl_module_path`): one met earlier in the run, else `M.cppm`, `.ccm`, `.cxxm`,
  `.ixx` or `.mpp` beside the importer, then on the path; `import :P` reads `M-P.cppm`. Its functions and initialized
  globals are spliced in `linkonce` (`ccl_module_split`); its classes and templates are read as the program's header.
  `import std;` and `import std.compat;` are a fixed header list (`ccl_std_module_headers`). `modules.cpp` (over
  `mathm.cppm` and `basem.cppm`). (0.108)
- A name the module does not export is not the importer's ([module.interface]/7): `ccl_module_hide` emits it as
  `N$Module` and rewrites the module's own uses (`ccl_note_export`, `'$ccl_exports'`, `ccl_exported`), so the importer
  sees it undeclared (`test/cpp/modhidden.cpp`). (0.110)
- A header unit's macros reach the importer ([module.import]/5; `pp_import_line`; `headerunit.cpp`). An inline function
  that the program's own `"..."` header defines is emitted once, `linkonce`, included or imported (`cpp_header_fns`;
  `hdrinline.cpp`). (0.110)

### Contracts

- C++26 contracts are enforced at run time: `pre(e)` and `post(r: e)` on a function or a method (`ccl_method_quals`,
  `ccl_contracts_apart`), and `contract_assert(e);`. `ccl_contract_body` checks the preconditions first, and the
  postconditions at each return (the result bound for `r`) and at a void function's end. A violation writes
  `contract violation: precondition|postcondition|assertion of F (line L)` to fd 2 and calls `abort()`
  (`contract_violation`). `contracts.cpp` (C++26) exits 134. (0.108)

### Function names and source locations

- THE FUNCTION'S OWN NAME, AS CLANG SPELLS IT (0.166; [dcl.fct.def.general]/8, clang's PredefinedExpr). In C++
  `__func__` and `__FUNCTION__` are the function's own name -- `m`, `K` for a constructor, `~K`, `operator+=`,
  `operator()`, `operator int` -- and `__PRETTY_FUNCTION__` its signature: the result and the parameters as written (a
  typedef by its name, an array or a function parameter as the pointer it decays to), the name with its namespaces and
  classes (`void ns::in::deep()`, `void K::In::im()`), `const`, `&` or `&&` after the parameters, `static ` or `virtual
  ` before it (an override is virtual), a conversion function's type as its result (`int K::operator int() const`), a
  template's PATTERN with its arguments in brackets (`T tf(T) [T = int]`, `void S<int, 4>::f() [T = int, N = 4]`, a pack
  `[Ts = <int, double, const char *>]`, a value as clang prints it (0.199; `cpp_pf_value/4`, `cpp_pf_char_lit/3`: its
  type's suffix, `[N = 4U]`, `[N = -3LL]`, another type cast, `[N = (short)9]`, a character type a character literal
  with its prefix and C's escapes, `[C = '\n']`, `[C = L'q']`, `[C = (unsigned char)'B']`, a placeholder's by its own
  type, `S<5U>::m() [N = 5U]`; an enumeration's value its enumerator as the source names it, `[V = Color::Green]`, `[V =
  P1]`, `[V = ns::K::b]`, else its number cast to it, `[V = (Color)7]` (0.203; `cpp_pf_enumerator/4`, `cpp_pf_class/2`);
  it was the number, `[N = 97]` for `f<'a'>()`), an `auto` parameter `[x:auto = int]`), a class template's arguments up
  to its defaulted ones (`U<int>` of `template <class T, unsigned N = 3>`), none for an explicit specialization, a
  lambda's through the function it is made in (`auto f(int)::(anonymous class)::operator()() const`), a local class's
  alike (`void L::loc()::Loc::lf()`). The three were this compiler's own name of the function, `K.m.0`. The desugaring
  keeps the function whose body it walks in `'$cpp_fsig'` -- `fsig(Kind, Class, Name, Result, Params, Variadic,
  Qualifiers, TemplateArgs)`, its result and parameters as written, an instance's its pattern's, set around each body's
  walk by `cpp_with_fsig/2` -- and spells it only where a name is used (`cpp_fsig_literal/2` over `cpp_pf/3`); a
  lambda's and a local class's function are noted where they are made (`'$cpp_pf_closure'/3`, `'$cpp_pf_local'/3`), and
  the lambda memo is keyed by that function too. In C the lowering spells `__PRETTY_FUNCTION__` (`ir_c_pretty/1`): `int
  main(void)`, `struct point *mk(void)`, `const char *const *cc(const int *const)`, and `int old()` for a definition
  written with no `void` before C23, as clang reads it. `prettyfn.cpp`, `test/c/run/prettyfn.c`. (0.166)
- A SOURCE LOCATION (0.166; [support.srcloc.cons]): `__builtin_source_location()`, which libc++'s
  `std::source_location::current()` reads through its default argument, is the address of a constant of libc++'s
  `source_location::__impl` -- the file as the compiler was given it (`'$ccl_src_file'`, set by `ccl_read_file/3` for
  the outermost read), `__PRETTY_FUNCTION__`'s text, the line and the column -- one constant per place
  (`'$cpp_srcloc'/2`, `cpp_srcloc/1`). The place is the call whose default argument it is, the OUTERMOST one
  (`'$cpp_dflt_site'`, set by `cpp_with_dflt_site/3` where `cpp_fill_defaults/3` fills a default and none is being
  filled): `log("x")` over `void log(const char *, std::source_location = std::source_location::current())` is the
  place of `log`, and `current()` written in a body its own. The column is found in the line's text: the callee's
  spelling, back over its qualifier, its template arguments and its object (`std::`, `a.`, `p->`, `(*p).`: clang 18's
  place -- clang 21 names a member call's member), a constructor's in a declaration its declarator's (`a` of `Lg
  a(1);`), a call that goes on past its line followed to the line of its callee; `decltype(__builtin_source_location())`
  is its type alone, no place made. Nothing answered the builtin, and every `std::source_location` was refused.
  `srcloc.cpp` (C++20). (0.166)
- CLANG'S SOURCE-LOCATION BUILTINS (0.201; `cpp_srcloc_builtin/2`, `cpp_srcloc_value/3`, `cpp_srcloc_here/4`; in C
  the lowering's `ir_call/4`): `__builtin_FILE()`, `__builtin_FILE_NAME()` (the file's base name), `__builtin_LINE()`,
  `__builtin_COLUMN()` and `__builtin_FUNCTION()` (`__func__`'s text) answer the place a source location has -- in a
  default argument the outermost call's, else their own, the builtin's name found in its line's text -- a file and a
  function as a `const char *` prvalue, a line and a column as an `unsigned int`, as clang types them
  (`ccl_srcloc_builtin_type/2`). glibc's `<assert.h>` writes `assert` on the first two in C++ (`__ASSERT_FILE` and
  `__ASSERT_LINE`, where `__has_builtin(__builtin_FILE)`), and every `assert` of a C++ program was refused,
  `undeclared('__builtin_FILE')`. `srcbuiltins.cpp`, `srcbuiltins.c`, `cwrap.cpp`. (0.201)

## libc++: how the library is compiled

### The owner's rule and the configuration

- (owner's rule) Nothing of the standard library is the compiler's own; the C side's freestanding headers
  (`library/include`) are the one exception. C++ compiles against libc++ as it is: C++17 first, then C++20, 23, 26.
  (0.41)
- (owner's rule) A library module is taken whole, its whole surface in fixtures, never function by function. (0.78)
- libc++ runs configurations that it ships, chosen by the predefined macros: no exceptions (0.50), RTTI since 0.191
  (without it from 0.86 to 0.190, and under `-fno-rtti`), libc++ 21's vectorized algorithms since 0.162
  (`__OPTIMIZE_SIZE__` no longer predefined; scalar ones from 0.92), `<atomic>` over `_Atomic` through
  `__has_extension(c_atomic)` (0.100). The preprocessor section has the details.
- `std::move(x)` is the language's own `move(x)`, with no header (`cpp_call` on `scoped([std], move)`). It stays a move
  on a class value or a value holding owners (`cpp_holds_owners/1`); an lvalue of a plain struct or of a scalar is the
  xvalue cast `static_cast<T &&>(x)` (0.122, 0.201), and any other is its operand. (0.40, 0.83, 0.201)

### Headers: the index and the load

- A flattened header's items become `'$cpp_hdr'(Key, Item)` facts (`cpp_index_header` over `ccl_flat_items/3`,
  `cpp_index_flat`), their namespace paths `'$cpp_hdr_ns'` facts. `cpp_index_name/2` keys a class by its definition
  (never a forward declaration), a function by its name, a member or static defined out of its class by the class, an
  extern global, an inline variable, an extern template by the template, a concept, and a guide as `$guide.<class>`. A
  summary-served header gives the same items from the AST file (`'$cpp_hdr_ast'`, `cpp_load_ast`); `cpp_hdr_item/2`
  reads either. (0.44, 0.45, 0.61, 0.75, 0.108)
- A header's LITERAL OPERATOR is indexed by its free operator name (`cpp_index_name`: `op.literal_s.2`), noted as a lazy
  inline function (`cpp_note_hdr_fns`, `cpp_register_lazy`: the item renamed to that name, the atom clause then declares
  it with its types resolved) and emitted `linkonce` where a literal calls it: `<string>`'s `operator""s`,
  `<string_view>`'s `operator""sv`. The four `operator""s` overloads (`char`, `wchar_t`, `char16_t`, `char32_t`) are one
  overload set, so a call resolves all four signatures (each `basic_string` instance is registered). (0.117)
- `cpp_hdr_load/1` loads a name's items once (`'$cpp_hdr_loaded'`): on the first miss of `cpp_class` or
  `cpp_class_template`, and on the first ask of `cpp_template` or the overload road (`cpp_hdr_join`, `cpp_fn_ready`), so
  a header's templates and functions join the program's. A load spends the instantiation budget (`cpp_spend/1`, 6000)
  and records `'$cpp_lib'(N)`. (0.44, 0.78)
- A load notes the out-of-class definitions first (`cpp_note_hdr_mdefs`), and runs inside `\+ \+`, at file scope
  (`cpp_isolated` around `cpp_register_lazy`), under `cpp_as_lib(yes, ...)`. A load that refuses throws through, since
  the name is marked loaded first. Else a load met in a function body declared the header's functions in its frame.
  (0.73, 0.80)

### Lazy classes, instances and functions

- A header's class is lazy (`'$cpp_lazy_c'`, `cpp_lazy_class`): registered, its struct emitted, and a member emitted when
  `cpp_method`, `cpp_ctor` or `cpp_own_dtor` first names it (`cpp_use_member/2`, `cpp_make_lazy/5`, trace
  `make_lazy(Name)`). The member is in progress while it emits (`'$cpp_making'`) and noted after; a failure refuses
  `member_not_emitted`. A class with no body (`class bad_alloc;`) registers nothing. The member made is the one of that
  name WHOSE REQUIRES-CLAUSE HOLDS, asked only of members that share the name, a refusal counted viable (`cpp_lazy_pick/4`, 0.136): libc++'s `__format_buffer` writes two constructors of one
  signature, `requires(same_as<_Storage, __internal_storage<_CharT>>)` and the `__direct_storage` one, which have one name;
  the first was taken, its clause unmet, nothing emitted and the name noted done (`undeclared(__format_buffer.char_p...)`
  wherever `std::format_to` writes through a `char *`, once the `conditional_t` rule let that buffer register).
  (0.44, 0.69, 0.136)
- A lazy polymorphic class emits only what its table names (`cpp_slot_fns`, in progress while walked); its other
  members come as named. (0.72)
- A library template's instance is lazy too (`cpp_lazy_instance/2`); else `push_back` compiled all of vector and stopped
  at `__swap_allocator`. The program's own instances stay eager, so the safe part sees them. (0.52)
- A member class template of a library class is the library's (`cpp_lib_origin/2` over `'$cpp_nested_tmpl'`): its
  instance is lazy and unchecked. Why: transform_view's `__iterator<_Const>` was checked as the program's, and its
  `__parent_(std::addressof(__parent))` was refused `untied`. (0.113)
- A header's free function is declared at the load with resolved types (`cpp_register_lazy`, `cpp_resolved_params`)
  and emitted `linkonce` where called (`cpp_use_fn/3`, origin `lazy(Item)`), once per overload, in progress while it
  emits and noted after; a failure refuses `function_not_emitted(Name)`. So the `__convert_to_integral` overloads over
  `__int128_t` are never emitted. It is declared under the name it is emitted under where the table holds no function of
  that name (`cpp_declare_emitted/1`, 0.202): a call names an overload by the parameters the pre-pass noted, raw, and the
  registration declared it by the ones it resolved, so `h == nullptr` of a `coroutine_handle<>` found its operator
  emitted and undeclared, `no_operator(==)`, a defect of 0.201 too. `corohandleeq.cpp` (C++20). (0.58, 0.73, 0.78,
  0.202)
- A library class's hidden friend is registered as a free function, its types resolved in its class
  (`cpp_register_lazy_friends`), and its body is walked in that class when emitted (`'$cpp_friend_in'`). Else
  filter_view's iterator `operator==`, which names its nested class bare, matched nothing. `stdviews.cpp`. (0.78, 0.112)
- The unit's own items come first in the bulk noter (`ccl_own_first` in `ccl_items_note`), so an emitted definition
  shadows a summary's raw declaration. (0.78)
- A header's function named as a value (`std::hex`) is emitted as a call would emit it (`cpp_lazy_fn_value`, one
  definition); an overload set goes by its target (`cpp_conv_to`). One the header only DECLARES, of one declaration, is
  the shipped library's: its Itanium symbol, declared (0.201; `cpp_use_mangled/3`) -- `<barrier>` hands
  `&__destroy_barrier_algorithm_base` to a unique_ptr as its deleter, and the plain name was an undefined symbol at the
  link. `stdsync.cpp`. (0.78, 0.99, 0.201)
- A header's C++17 inline variable, which no library exports (`__digits_base_10`), is a `linkonce` global of the
  program that names it (`cpp_lazy_inline_var`), its initializer desugared; an `auto` one takes the initializer's type
  (`ranges::iter_move`). A global of an empty class is its zero bytes, with no constructor run (`nullopt`,
  `piecewise_construct`); with no initializer it is value-initialized ([dcl.init]/8): `std::ignore`. (0.73, 0.82, 0.90,
  0.109)
- A nested class of a library class is the library's (`cpp_lib_class` via `'$cpp_encl'`). A library class's `consteval`
  constructor keeps its member initializers and drops its body at run time; the body is a compile-time check,
  `basic_format_string`'s format parse, which the evaluator runs where the object is made since 0.164 (the Constant
  evaluation topic; `cpp_member_fns`, `cpp_ce_twin/7`, trace `consteval_ctor_unchecked` where the twin cannot be
  desugared). (0.84, 0.110, 0.164)

### Library functions are not checked

- A function from a library header is `'$cpp_libfn'(Name)`: an inline one, a lazy member, an instance of a header's
  template, or what such a walk emits (`cpp_as_lib/2`; a template's origin `'$cpp_lib'(N)`). The check skips it
  (`cpp_library_function/1` in `ck_items`); the lowering lowers it. libc++ keeps raw pointers by its own discipline,
  which the safe part refuses. The program's functions and its own templates' instances are checked. (0.45)
- A CLOSURE MADE IN A LIBRARY'S WALK IS THE LIBRARY'S CLASS (0.201; `'$cpp_lib_closure'/1` in `cpp_lib_class/1`): a
  generic lambda's call operator template is instantiated where it is called, and its instance takes its class's origin
  (`cpp_make_member/9`) -- the program's, for a closure made in a free function template of a header, which no
  enclosing class makes the library's: libc++ 18's `__pstl_transform_reduce` makes `[__transform, __reduce](auto
  __brick_first, auto __brick_last, _Tp __brick_init) { ... std::move(__transform) ... }`, and its instance was checked
  as the program's, `move of a non-owner`. `execpol.cpp`. (0.201)
- A library class's value is opaque to the check (`ck_carries_`, `ck_library_class`) and can be moved
  (`ck_moves_library`). A plain pointer that its member returns borrows the object (`ck_borrows_from`), and such a
  borrow can be consumed (`ck_library_root`). (0.79, 0.86, 0.91, 0.94)

### Namespaces: flattening and collisions

- Namespaces flatten to bare names. A qualified type that is no deeper namespace's key and no class goes through the
  type hook again as its bare name (`cpp_type`, trace `flatten(Path, N, in(W))`), so `std::string` reaches the lowering
  as the instance. A file-scope alias in a path is the class it names (`cpp_path_class`: `std::string::npos`). (0.32,
  0.63, 0.84)
- When two namespaces declare one flattened name, the outermost keeps the bare name and a deeper one's item is keyed
  by the shortest unique suffix of its namespace path (`cpp_ns_quals`, `cpp_ns_unique_suffix`, `cpp_index_key`,
  `cpp_qualify_item`; 0.112, where it was the innermost namespace alone). A qualified use resolves to the key
  (`cpp_ns_key` in `cpp_type`, `cpp_call`, `cpp_expr`), a qualified template-id called too (`__elements::__fn<0>{}`,
  views::keys). Else `function<int(int)>` took the wrong `__maybe_derive_from_unary_function`. An ALIAS TEMPLATE is
  keyed so too (0.181; `cpp_qualify_item/4`): std::pmr::basic_string is `pmr.basic_string`. It kept the bare name, and
  where <string> was unread it won the name from the class template that <iosfwd> declares: its body names
  `std::basic_string<_CharT, _Traits, polymorphic_allocator<_CharT>>`, which resolved through it again without end, and
  a call over `const std::string &` ran to the memory cap with no trace line (`fwdstring.cpp`). (0.88, 0.112, 0.181)
- A QUALIFIED CLASS NAME THAT TWO HEADERS' READS DECLARE IN TWO NAMESPACES takes its namespace's items (0.218;
  `cpp_cross_key/3` in `cpp_type/2`, after `cpp_ns_key/3`): a read keys apart only the names that collide in it, so
  `__traits` is bare in `<string>`'s read (std::__variant_detail's: `<string>` holds `<variant>`'s implementation) and
  bare in `<charconv>`'s (std::__itoa's), and the first header's item answered the bare name -- `#include <string>`,
  `<memory>`, `<algorithm>` or `<system_error>` before `#include <charconv>` refused `std::from_chars`,
  `instance_refused(..., no_member_type('__traits.unsigned', type))`, where `__itoa::__traits<_Tp>` meant `<charconv>`'s
  (over 0.217 too). Where the qualifier's own key is no read's, the bare name's first item stands in another namespace,
  and the qualifier names one of the others, that namespace's items are kept under the key one read would have given
  them (`cpp_ns_unique_suffix/3`: `__itoa.__traits`), renamed as such a read renames them (`cpp_qualify_item/4`,
  `cpp_rename_names/3`), with their path. The AST beside a summary writes each item's path right after it, so the items
  and the paths of a name pair one to one, or nothing is done; a header indexed in the process (`'$cpp_hdr'`) is left as
  it was. The first item's path is asked first, and a qualifier it ends with (`std::vector`, most names) stops there.
  Classes and class templates only: a namespace's functions and objects overload and are found by other roads
  (`std::abs` is std's and std::__math's). An unqualified use is renamed where its item registers (0.219, below).
  `charconvorder.cpp`. (0.218, 0.219)
- A HEADER'S ITEMS ARE REGISTERED IN THEIR OWN NAMESPACE'S WORDS (0.219; `cpp_hdr_load_items/2` in `cpp_hdr_load/1`,
  over `cpp_cross_table/1` and `cpp_cross_map/3`): an UNQUALIFIED class name in an item, that two headers' reads declare
  in two namespaces, names what C++'s lookup finds from the item's own namespace out ([basic.lookup.unqual]), the
  innermost of its enclosing namespaces that declares the name (`cpp_ns_innermost/3`). Where that is not the namespace
  of the bare name's first item, the use goes to the key one read would have given that namespace's items
  (`cpp_cross_make/4`, the qualified road's maker), as a read renames a deeper namespace's bare uses
  (`cpp_qualify_body/4`). `#include <charconv>` before `#include <variant>` refused `std::variant<int>`,
  `base_not_registered('__copy_assignment.__traits.int...')`: `<variant>`'s `__traits<_Types...>`, named bare inside
  std::__variant_detail, took `<charconv>`'s `__itoa::__traits<_Tp>`, the first item (`std::variant<int, double>` built,
  the one-parameter template fitting no such list). The table of such names, each with its paths and its first item's,
  is made once for the ASTs loaded (`cpp_ast_gen_next/0` counts them, `'$cpp_ast_gen'`), and each namespace's renames
  once for it (`'$cpp_cross_map'/3`); a key that cannot be made is noted (`'$cpp_cross_none'/1`). A CLASS DECLARED AND
  NOT DEFINED is renamed with the rest (`cpp_cross_fwd_item/4`): libc++'s `template <class _Fp> class __base;`, the
  primary of std::__function's `__base<_Rp(_ArgTypes...)>`, kept its bare name, and `<string>` before `<functional>` met
  `template_without_body('__function.__base')` while this step was probed. Classes and class templates only; a header
  indexed in the process (`'$cpp_hdr'`) goes as it is. `crossread.cpp`. ... AND THE FIRST ITEM'S OWN NAMESPACE TOO,
  where another namespace's item of the name is a function or an object (0.221; [basic.lookup.unqual]/1,
  [basic.lookup.argdep]/3: the class that ordinary lookup finds hides them, and no argument's namespace is asked;
  `cpp_cross_mixed/2` in `cpp_cross_map_/3`): every item of a name is loaded under the bare name, so the bare name held
  both kinds, and a call took the function's road. libc++ 21's `inline constexpr auto transform = __transform{};` in
  std::ranges, `<algorithm>` read before `<sstream>`, which brings std::__formatter's function template
  `__transform(first, last, out, op)`, called the function with no argument, `arity_mismatch`, and every
  `std::ranges::transform` was refused (read after `<sstream>`, the class was keyed already); `<format>` before
  `<algorithm>` at C++23 did the same to `std::ranges::upper_bound`, std's function `__upper_bound` beside ranges'

- A function that a library header declares and never defines, not `extern "C"`, with a known namespace path, is called
  by its Itanium symbol (`cpp_mangled_name/3`, parameters resolved first). Its prototype is emitted once with the
  ellipsis, resolved types and defaults (`cpp_use_mangled/3`, `cpp_fn_variadic/1`, `cpp_fn_arity_fits/3`):
  `_ZNSt3__122__libcpp_verbose_abortEPKcz`, `std::stoi`. The prototype is DECLARED AT FILE SCOPE (`ccl_gdeclare/1`;
  0.117), not in the innermost frame: an instance's body walk is one, the name was noted done, and the second function
  that called `__thread_local_data()` met a call of no type (`unknown`), so `.set_pointer(...)` on its result refused
  `no_member`: a program with two kinds of `std::thread`. `stdthread.cpp`. (0.61, 0.108, 0.117)
- A member that a header declares and the shipped library defines takes its symbol where declared, called and slotted
  (`cpp_mangle/4`). `cpp_shipped_member` says which: no body in the class, not pure, not defined out of the class
  (`cpp_defined_out_of_class`), operators included. It asks the facts of the members the class only declares
  (`'$cpp_decl'/4`, 0.153), never the class's record. Its parameters are resolved in the class first
  (`ctype<char>::do_narrow`). A const one keeps its symbol, which spells `K`, where the compiler's own name ends `.c`
  (`cpp_shipped_member_q`). (0.73, 0.79, 0.153)

  called by its symbol (`cpp_dtor_name`: `_ZNSt3__18ios_baseD1Ev`), any other is `C.dtor.0`; a constructor with no body
  is a declaration under its symbol (`bad_alloc()`). (0.46, 0.72, 0.73, 0.90)

  `this` (`cpp_note_static_abi/2`, `'$cpp_static_abi'`; 0.127). The desugaring keeps its own null first argument, which

### Builtins answered

- `cpp_builtin_call/3` answers libc++'s builtins as this compiler can:
  - `__builtin_is_constant_evaluated` is false, and `__builtin_constant_p` is 0;
  - `__builtin_operator_new` and `__builtin_operator_delete` are the global allocation and deallocation functions their
    arguments name -- a size, an alignment, the nothrow tag -- as written-out `::operator new` and `::operator delete`
    are (`cpp_operator_new/3`, 0.202: `malloc` and `free` at any arity, an alignment dropped);
  - `__builtin_launder`, `__builtin_assume_aligned` and `__builtin_expect` give their operand, and
    `__builtin_addressof(X)` is `addr(X)`;
  - `__builtin_assume`, `__builtin_assume_dereferenceable`, `__builtin_unreachable` and `__builtin_prefetch` are
    nothing;
  - `__builtin_source_location()` is the place of the call whose default argument it is (0.166, the topic Function
    names and source locations);
  - `__builtin_invoke(f, args...)` is the call, through `cpp_memptr_call` for a member pointer (`stdinvoke.cpp`); a pointer to
    a DATA member applied to an object is `o.*pm`, to a pointer to one `p->*pm` ([func.require]/1.4, 1.5;
    `cpp_invoke_object/4`): the object must be of the member's class or a class derived from it, else the call is refused
    (`invoke_object(C)`, what `is_invocable_v<int Pt::*, int>` reads); the result carries the object's `const` and, for an
    rvalue object, is an xvalue (`int &&`; `cpp_invoke_result/4`). libc++ 21 writes `std::invoke` and `__invoke_result` on
    it, where libc++ 18 had overloads of `__invoke` that read `std::forward<_A0>(__a0).*__f`. `invokedata.cpp`.
    (0.50, 0.60, 0.80, 0.92, 0.100, 0.126)
- `__builtin_bit_cast(T, e)` ([bit.cast]; `cpp_trait/3`, 0.117) is a statement expression: a local of T, a local copy of
  e (its type unref'd and unqualified), a `memcpy` of `sizeof(T)` bytes between them, the local of T last. <bit>'s
  `std::bit_cast` is `return __builtin_bit_cast(_ToType, __from);`; the builtin was `trait_unknown`. `stdbitcast.cpp`.
- The memory builtins are libc's: `memcpy`, `memmove`, `memset`, `memcmp`, `memchr`, `strlen`, and
  `__builtin_char_memchr` as `memchr`. `ir_cpp_prelude` declares `free`, `memcpy`, `memmove` and `memset` where the
  file did not, and the replaceable allocation functions (0.202, `malloc` and `calloc` before). `__builtin_wmemchr`, `wmemcmp` and `wcslen` are libc's, declared where no header did
  (`cpp_wide_fn`): `std::find` of an int goes that road. (0.60, 0.76, 0.92)
- The math builtins are libm's (`cpp_math_fn`, `cpp_math_stem`, `cpp_math_shape`): `f` float, `l` libm's own long double
  function, each declared once where no header did (`cpp_math_declared`): the rehash's `__builtin_ceilf`. `scalbn` and
  `ldexp` take (T, int), `frexp` (T, int *), `modf` (T, T *), and `ilogb` answers an int (`cpp_math_odd/4`):
  `<complex>`'s division calls `std::scalbn` and `std::logb`. `__builtin_abs`, `labs` and `llabs` are the C library's
  too (libc++'s `<stdlib.h>` writes `abs(long)` through `__builtin_labs`). (0.81, 0.108, 0.117)
- `__builtin_popcount` and its forms fold where their argument folds, over the type's width (`cpp_popcount`): libc++'s
  `digits`. `__builtin_offsetof` comes from the layout (`cpp_trait`, `cpp_offsetof`). (0.45, 0.60, 0.94)

### Traits answered

- The traits are decided in the desugaring: `cpp_trait` (`__is_same`, `__builtin_offsetof`), `cpp_trait_of` (the
  one-type tests), `cpp_trait_n` (constructible, assignable, convertible, base_of) and `cpp_builtin_type` (the type
  traits). An unknown one refuses `trait_unknown(N)`; a nothrow one answers the declarations (0.193, below). A `type(T)`
  argument is a type (`cpp_expr(_, type(T0), type(T))`): libc++ 18's `is_copy_constructible`. (0.44, 0.93)
- THE NOTHROW TRAITS ANSWER THE DECLARATIONS (0.193; [meta.unary.prop], [except.spec]/8, /10; `cpp_nothrow_ctor/2`,
  `cpp_nothrow_assign/2`): `__is_nothrow_constructible`, `__is_nothrow_assignable` and `__is_nothrow_convertible` hold
  where the plain trait holds and the construction or assignment is known not to throw -- a scalar's always; a class's
  copy or move its constructor's or assignment's declared `noexcept`, a move the class does not declare beside a copy it
  declares being the copy ([class.copy.ctor]/8), else the implicit one's, every data member's and base sub-object's own
  (`cpp_nothrow_parts/2`); its default construction the declared default constructor's, else the implicit one's, a
  default member initializer that calls taken as throwing; any other construction or assignment where every candidate of
  the arity asked, a constructor template among them, is declared `noexcept`. A refusal met while asking answers as the
  plain trait (`cpp_nothrow_q/1`). They were the plain traits, which libc++'s no-exceptions configuration could take; its
  exceptions configuration asks them in `std::move_if_noexcept`, and a vector grows by COPYING an element whose move
  constructor may throw where it has a copy (`nothrowtraits.cpp`). A declared `noexcept(E)` counts where E holds in the
  class, its parameters declared (0.199; `cpp_qs_nothrow/3`): `W(W &&) noexcept(sizeof(T) > 1)` is nothrow for `W<int>`
  and not for `W<char>`, and a vector of a class whose move constructor is `noexcept(sizeof(int) > 8)` copies as it grows
  (`nxcond.cpp`, `nxguard.cpp`). (0.193, 0.199)
- A PLAIN STRUCT IS ITS OWN BASE (`__is_base_of`, `cpp_base_of/2`; [meta.rel]: `is_base_of<T, T>` holds for a class that is
  no union; 0.126): a struct of data members alone is no registered class and has no base, so only itself, and a pointer to
  it is none. It was false, and libc++ 18's `__enable_if_bullet4` of `__invoke` (`is_same<_ClassT, _DecayA0>::value ||
  is_base_of<_ClassT, _DecayA0>::value`) read it. `memptrqual.cpp`. (0.112, 0.126)
- `__builtin_is_virtual_base_of(B, D)` (clang's, under C++26's `std::is_virtual_base_of` of libc++ 21; 0.194;
  `cpp_trait_n/4` over `cpp_vbases_of/2`): B a virtual base of D at any depth, cv-qualifiers aside; a plain base, the
  class itself and an unrelated class are none. `vbaseof.cpp` (C++26, libc++ 21).
- `*e` OF AN ARITHMETIC VALUE IS REFUSED (`cpp_deref_operand/1`, `deref_of_arithmetic(T)`; 0.126), as an operator on a class
  that has none is: an operand whose type is KNOWN and arithmetic (an enumeration included). A detection reads it --

- `__array_rank(T)` and `__array_extent(T, I)` ([meta.unary.prop.query]; 0.167) are an array's rank and the extent of
  its I-th dimension, 0 past its rank or for an unbounded one (`cpp_array_rank/2`, `cpp_array_extent/3`): libc++'s
  `rank_v` and `extent_v` are the builtins where clang has them, and nothing answered them (`trait_unknown`), which no
  program met before a literal was an array.
- THE TRAITS OF A CONSTRUCTION, A CONVERSION AND AN ASSIGNMENT ASK THE MEMBERS THAT TAKE THE VALUES (0.200;
  [meta.unary.prop], [meta.rel], [dcl.init], [dcl.init.ref], [over.match.ctor]; `cpp_constructible/2`, `cpp_convertible/2`,
  `cpp_assignable/2`), `declval<A>()` an lvalue where A is an lvalue reference and an rvalue else (`cpp_value_cat/3`). A

  `cpp_ref_collapsed/2`): one to a non-const type an lvalue of a compatible type, or the lvalue a class value's conversion
  function gives; one to a const type, and an rvalue reference, a compatible value or a temporary of what converts to the

  an lvalue or a const value the copy. A copy or a move is as the class declares it (`'$cpp_sdecl'/4`, noted by

  ([class.conv]/4), so a class value never reaches a converting constructor's non-class parameter, and a converting

  enumeration and from no scoped one ([dcl.enum]/10); a pointer to `bool`; `void *` to no other pointer, a

  `valtraits.cpp`, `valtraits20.cpp` (C++20), `valtraitsown.cpp`, `valtraitsconv.cpp`, `valtraitsspecial.cpp`,
  `valtraitsmore.cpp`. (0.46, 0.90, 0.93, 0.200)

- A conversion to a class asks the source's type (`cpp_converting/2`): a constructor whose parameter takes its kind.
  Why: any one-argument constructor counted, and `is_convertible<const wchar_t *, string_view>` was true. (0.115)
- `__is_trivially_equality_comparable` (`cpp_trait_of`) is true for the integral types and pointers. It is false for a
  floating type (0.0 == -0.0 with other bits), a class, and an enum (`cpp_enum_type/1`), since a program may write its

- An enumeration is no arithmetic type ([basic.fundamental]): `__is_integral`, `__is_arithmetic`, `__is_signed` and

- `__is_signed` AND `__is_unsigned` BY THE INFERENCE'S OWN TEST (0.221; [basic.fundamental]/9, [meta.unary.prop]: `T(-1)
  < T(0)`; `ccl_int_rank/3`): `char8_t`, `char16_t` and `char32_t` are unsigned, plain `char` and `wchar_t` unsigned on

  calls, failed its static assertion (`u8lit20.cpp` over libc++ 21 in 0.221's gate).

  pointer to member. `__is_final` asks the class's `final` (`'$cpp_final'/1`, the C++ reader's Classes topic): it was

- FOUR TRAITS THE LIBRARY ASKS THE COMPILER (0.206; each was `trait_unknown`), as clang 21 answers them:

  enumeration type whose bits fill its bytes (a `_BitInt` with padding bits is none), a pointer, a pointer to member, an

  never a floating type, `std::nullptr_t` or an empty class. `__is_scoped_enum` (C++23) asks `cpp_scoped_enum_value/1`.
  `__builtin_is_implicit_lifetime` and `__is_implicit_lifetime` (C++23, [basic.types.general]/9, [class.prop]/9;

  registered class: `std::is_aggregate_v<P>` of `struct P { int x; double y; };` was 0. `ftm17b.cpp`, `ftm23.cpp`.
- `__is_class` of a NESTED class known by name, registered or not (no union), is true (0.132; `cpp_nested_class_named/1`):

  while it registers -- refused, the iterator's registration stopped before its friends, and `it != end` had no operator.
- `__is_volatile` reads the top-level qualifiers, a pointer's included, and so does `__is_const` since 0.167, an array's
  being its element's ([basic.type.qualifier]/3: `is_const<const char[4]>` and `is_const<int *const>` were false);
  `__is_abstract` asks `cpp_abstract_class/1`.
  The member-pointer traits answer on `memptr(...)`; libc++ 18 picks its `__invoke` overloads by them
  (`memptrtraits.cpp`, `stdbind.cpp`). `decltype` of a call through a member function pointer is the member's result,
  its reference kept: `cpp_decltype_of` reads the statement expression `cpp_memptr_call` makes (`cpp_called_fn/3`: the
  last call through a cast to the function type or through a local of it), and the lowering binds a reference result
  through such a statement expression (`ir_ref_result/2` in `ir_ref_of`). Why: the clause on the bare call matched
  nothing since 0.100, so `std::invoke(pm, s) += 2` over `int &(S::*)()` wrote into a dead copy. `memptrdecl.cpp`.
  (0.93, 0.100, 0.112)
- The reference-temporary traits (`__reference_constructs_from_temporary`, `__reference_converts_from_temporary`,
  `__reference_binds_to_temporary`) and `__builtin_{lt,le,gt,ge}_synthesizes_from_spaceship` are false (`cpp_trait`).
  (0.84)
- `cpp_builtin_type`: `__remove_cv`, `__remove_const` and `__remove_cvref` strip a pointer's own qualifiers too, and an
  array's element's (`cpp_strip_quals`, 0.167: `remove_const_t<const char[4]>` is `char[4]`, which libc++'s format takes
  as a string) and keep a named type; `__remove_extent`, `__remove_all_extents`, `__add_pointer`,
  `__remove_pointer`, `__decay`, `__add_lvalue_reference` and `__add_rvalue_reference` (collapsing), `__make_unsigned`
  and `__make_signed` (`cpp_signedness/3`) answer. `__underlying_type(E)` is the enum's written base ([dcl.enum]), else
  `int` when an enumerator is negative and `unsigned` otherwise (`cpp_underlying_of/2`; the lowering's size for an
  unfixed enum is 4 bytes). `underlyingtype.cpp`. (0.60, 0.72, 0.79, 0.86, 0.117)

### The ordering classes of `<compare>`

- `<compare>`'s ordering classes are libc++'s own, loaded on demand (`cpp_ordering_class`). A scalar `<=>` is
  `strong_ordering` for integers and pointers, `partial_ordering` for floating operands (`cpp_scalar_ordering`), valued
  as the private constructor builds it (`cpp_ordering_value`: one `signed char`, -1, 0, 1, or -127 unordered). `o < 0`
  and `std::is_lt(o)` reach the hidden friends. Without `<compare>`, a scalar `<=>` is an int. `stdcompare.cpp`. (0.101)
- A defaulted `<=>` answers the class written, else the common category of its pieces, else an int
  (`cpp_defaulted_ordering`). The pieces are `pc(A, B, T)` (`cpp_cmp_pieces`), the base first, an array element by
  element; a floating piece makes it partial and compares unordered on NaN ([class.spaceship]/2; `cpp_cmp_sign`).
  `std::compare_three_way` and `common_comparison_category_t` follow (`stdcompare2.cpp`). (0.101, 0.103, 0.104)

## The safe part

### The check in the build

- `library/ccl_check.pl` checks ownership before anything is lowered. `ccl_ir_units/2` runs `ccl_check_noted/1` over
  the table it built, after the C++ desugaring. `ccl_check_units/1` builds a table of its own. A violation is a
  compile error. Each function is walked inside `\+ \+` (`ck_items/1`). A walk that merely fails says
  `check_failed(Name)` under the C++ trace. (M3, 0.80, 0.108)
- Every local joins the symbol table (`ccl_declare/2`, a scope per block). So `ccl_type_of/2` types every slot, and
  `ck_is_local/1` tells a local from a global or a static. Every statement carries its line first; `ccl_add_lines/3`
  gives a macro's short forms the call's line. `ck_line/1` keeps the line. `ck_short/2` names a form without its line,
  and `ck_squash/2` without a macro's expansion. (M3)

### Owners and moves

- An owner is a pointer qualified `own`. C's grammar puts the qualifier on the pointee (`own char *p` is `ptr([],
